neighbours.label: words about letter case (uppercase, lowercase, capitalize, capital letter), in prose and in code; not 'capital' as a city or money, not 'upper' as position
fire: Passwords must contain at least one uppercase character and one digit.
Our style guide says to capitalize every noun in a German heading.
The poet e. e. cummings often wrote his name in lowercase on the cover.
Convert the column to lowercase so that the search ignores differences in spelling.
Each proper noun in the essay begins with a capital letter, the teacher reminded us.
Early typewriters printed only capital letters, which made long reports tiring to read.
Editors disagree about the capitalization of 'internet' in newspaper copy.
quiet: Passwords must contain at least twelve characters and one digit.
Our style guide says to underline every noun in a German heading.
The poet e. e. cummings often wrote his name in pencil on the cover.
Convert the column to integers so that the search ignores differences in spelling.
Each province in the essay has a capital city, the teacher reminded us.
Early venture firms supplied only capital and advice, which made long projects tiring to fund.
Editors disagree about the upper limit on word counts in newspaper copy.

notes: Probes: '_upper' 0.97, 'capital letter' 0.72, uppercase 0.65, capitalize 0.47, capitals 0.43; capital of France 0.01, investors' capital 0.00, upper bedroom 0.00, suitcase 0.00.
